name: Button
purpose: Render a finished accessible action or emphasized native link with Brick size, tone, variant, loading, and composition contracts.
useWhen: The user triggers an action such as submit, save, open, dismiss, or retry.
A destination intentionally needs a filled, soft, outlined, or ghost action treatment.

avoidWhen.condition: A destination should read as ordinary inline or standalone navigation.

composition: Omit href for actions and supply href for emphasized destinations; choose tone, variant, and size from intent and add an icon only when it improves recognition.

rules.statement: Use action mode for operations and href link mode for emphasized destinations; visual prominence never justifies hiding navigation in onPress.
Load styles.css or core.css plus button.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Navigating from onPress without a real href.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Button href mode for emphasized navigation or Link for ordinary navigation.

validation: Confirm an accessible name and action semantics.
Test focus, keyboard activation, disabled/loading behavior, and contrast in every supported appearance.
